lines: Uh-huh-huh-huh!! Stop getting in my way, you Orcz!!
I'll put you through the air fryer and turn you into food for Patrasche!!
Hey, you rotten Oni! I'd like to see you try it?!!
The Oni, the gangsters, and the Orcs clashed, and fierce battles erupted all over the small bar.
Uwahwahwah!!? A-Are you all ok!? It turned into a pretty big fightー
What, don't worry about it. This happens all the time around here!!
The Orc Mercenary laughed heartily and returned fire.
Perhaps it was due to his combat experience, but even against the vicious gangsters he easily stood his ground.
Hmhmm... But it's going to be a pain if this drags on, so I'll clean them up with my strongest...
With a drunkenly flushed face, Kurenai shakily held up her two swords.
If you go all out in a tiny-ass place like this, you'll tear all of us to shreds!!
Argh, seriously! With you two here I can't even concentrate on fighting!
With that, the Orc mercenary pointed to a door behind the bar counter.
That stupid Oni is after you two, isn't he?
ーWe'll take care of those guys, so you go out through the back!!
Yeah! Just leave it to us, Mari-chan!
In exchange, let me give your tits a quick squeeze later!! Gehehe!!
As they laughed merrily, the orc mercenaries gathered and formed a wall to block the gangsters' way.
Uh-huh-huh-huh!! I won't let you get away that easily!
Shut up! Leave them alone, you creepy Oni bastard!!
The battle between the gangsters and the Orc mercenaries heated upー Kurenai took a quick look at it and called out to Mari.
Mari, let's take them up on their offerー We owe you!
Y-Yes! Everyone, thank you very much...!
Mari and Kurenai gave thanks to the mercenaries, then made a dash for the back door.
